subject: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Brown <maya@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot

Hi Maya,

Congrats again on getting the agreement signed — excited to get Novamed live. I wanted to send a brief handoff note ahead of the kickoff so CS and implementation can start planning with clear owners and early risk awareness. I copied the implementation and provisioning leads on our side.

High-level scope (what we committed to):
- Hosted Redwood API for inference + a Dedicated reserved pool for peak throughput (2x p40-equivalent).
- Retention window: 90 days (customer-managed KMS).
- Initial models: redwood-ggml-7B (quantized) + a reranking pipeline for clinical triage.

Target go-live: 2027-01-20 (soft launch with a subset of traffic).

Key next steps I want confirmed before kickoff:
1) Customer technical point of contact for network/VPN and API keys.
2) SOW finalization — attached is the draft (NOVAMED_SOW_v0.9.pdf). Any redlines need to be flagged this week.
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) — I attached a working MAP (mutual-action-plan-novamed.xlsx). Please add internal deadlines and owners ahead of our kickoff.
4) Any compliance or security evidence the customer expects in the first 2 weeks (SOC2 extracts, encryption attestations).

Early risks we've flagged internally:
- Network/VPN provisioning lead time on the Novamed side (if they require on-prem peering, that could push timelines).
- Model acceptance tests: clinical reranking may need 1–2 extra eval rounds for precision at our SLA.
- Billing and quota alignment for burst capacity in week 1.

Internal asks to speed things up:
- Please confirm the technical contact (name + email) who will own VPN/infra and give ETA for providing firewall rules.
- Confirm whether Novamed needs our Private deployment option (VPC) or will accept hosted + dedicated.

I'll propose two kickoff slots for the team — one during the week of Dec 13 and a later one Dec 20 if you need more time to marshal IT.

Thanks — short replies are fine. Once we have the technical contact I'll have Ben scope the provisioning checklist and Tessa will own the success plan.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success (Sales handoff)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: NOVAMED_SOW_v0.9.pdf (draft, 7 pages); mutual-action-plan-novamed.xlsx (working)

From: Maya Brown <maya@novamed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot

Grace — thanks and congrats to your team as well.

Quick answers:
- Technical contact: Evan Li <evan@novamed.com>, Senior Infrastructure Engineer. I'll introduce him on a separate calendar invite.
- Novamed currently prefers hosted + dedicated. We will confirm by EOD if we need the on-prem/private option, but initial preference is to avoid on-prem unless the security team pushes back.
- For compliance: we will need SOC2 Type II summary and KMS integration docs in the first 7 days. Can you point me to the standard artifacts?

We can do the earlier kickoff week of Dec 13. Evan is available Dec 14 (morning PT) and Dec 16 (afternoon PT).

Maya Brown
Director, Product & Partnerships
Novamed Therapeutics

Date: 2026-12-08 12:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot

Thanks Grace — looping in a short ops plan and initial tasking below.

Summary of assignments (internal only):
- Primary CS owner / kickoff lead: Tessa Morgan — owns success plan, adoption metrics, acceptance criteria, weekly check-ins.
- Provisioning and infra lead: Priyom Das — owns capacity allocation, dedicated pool provisioning, and KMS setup.
- Technical integration / API lead: Ben Carter (me) — will run the technical intake, network checklist, and model QA gating.

Immediate tasks (next 5 business days):
- Tessa: draft 30/60/90 adoption milestones in MAP tab "Adoption Plan" (due 2026-12-15).
- Priyom: validate dedicated pool SKU with infra ops and send provisioning ETA + required customer firewall CIDRs (due 2026-12-10).
- Ben: prepare technical intake doc (network checklist + model evaluation plan) and SOC2 artifact list for Maya (due 2026-12-10).

Risks / mitigation notes:
- If Novamed requests Private deployment, we need to run a separate security scoping call; Priyom — flag cost/ops delta ASAP.
- Model evaluation: allow a 7-business-day buffer for second eval cycle. Tessa please include this in the MAP as a conditional milestone.

Attachments: I uploaded a link to the SOW draft and MAP on the shared drive (link below). I'll put calendar holds for Evan and the rest once Maya confirms a final kickoff slot.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://redwood.app/drive/NOVAMED/MutualActionPlan

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot

Thanks — I accept the CS lead. Quick granular plan from my side:

Tessa's implementation checklist (ownership items):
- Day 0 (pre-kickoff): populate MAP Adoption Plan with stakeholders and A/C; send intake survey to Novamed PMs (due 2026-12-10).
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm A/C, confirm test dataset and ops playbook, set up escalation path.
- Week 1–2: run initial model validation with Ben; collect metrics and run reranking smoke tests.
- Week 3–4: rollout pilot traffic to 5% of sessions; measure latency/cost and adjust batching/quantization profiles with Priyom.

I will also prepare a one-pager for Novamed that explains the go-live checklist and acceptance criteria (delivery 2026-12-15).

Open asks for Evan / Novamed:
- Can we get a small sample (anonymized) dataset for the reranking eval by Dec 17?
- Confirm whether SSO integration is required in the first 30 days (if yes, we should scope SSO in separate task).

I will take ownership of running weekly syncs post-kickoff and will post calendar invites once Grace confirms the kickoff slot.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Brown <maya@novamed.com>, Evan Li <evan@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08 17:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-sign: kickoff readiness, owner asks, and early risk snapshot

Thanks everyone — great cadence. Maya / Evan, Dec 14 10:00–11:00 PT works for our side for a kickoff (I've tentatively booked it): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novamed-kickoff-20270110

Action items for the customer before kickoff:
- Evan: share sample dataset or data schema for reranking (or confirm NDA gating if needed).
- Maya: confirm whether SOC2 summary can be shared with Ben prior to the call.

Internal follow-ups (Ben/Priyom/Tessa) as outlined — please update the MAP by EOD Friday so I can share the version with Novamed ahead of kickoff.

I'll convert the tentative into a confirmed invite once Evan accepts. Looking forward to a smooth rollout.

Best,
Grace
